# Hash-locked install set for docker/Dockerfile.deps-core (the non-ML extras:
# web, cache, feedback, pgvector, mcp), resolved for Python 3.12 (.python-version)
# on every platform. The image installs this with --require-hashes, so a PyPI
# release published after this file was written cannot reach a build.
#
# Regenerate after changing pyproject.toml dependencies or on a version bump
# (uv >= 0.13):
#   uv pip compile pyproject.toml --universal --python-version 3.12 \
#     --extra web --extra cache --extra feedback --extra pgvector --extra mcp \
#     --generate-hashes --no-header -o docker/core-lock/requirements.txt
# To take a newer release of one package: add --upgrade-package <name>.
# tests/test_python_lock_guard.py fails if the extras here and in the
# Dockerfile drift apart or the Dockerfile installs without this file.
